title: Nonlinear Feature Geometry: Testing for 'Onion' Representations in Safety-Relevant Layers
original_idea: Train linear and nonlinear (2-layer MLP) probes at each layer of GPT-2 Small for safety-relevant concepts. Compare accuracy. For layers with >5% gap, investigate nonlinear manifold via PCA.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If safety-relevant concepts are nonlinearly encoded, the entire SAE/linear-probe interpretability stack needs extension. Important methodological finding.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear and MLP probes in sklearn/PyTorch are standard. Running at each layer with TransformerLens is documented. PCA analysis is simple. Well within beginner capability.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear comparison: linear vs. nonlinear probes, per-layer, one accuracy threshold (5%), PCA follow-up. Well-structured deliverable.
